result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane residential thoroughfare with a painted center median but no visible marked pedestrian crossings. The road design prioritizes vehicle throughput with wide lanes and long sightlines, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians despite the adjacent row housing.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes and a center turn lane without any protected refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes extending into the distance

hazards.name: Lack of designated crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block or at unmarked locations.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Convert the painted center median into raised refuge islands to allow for two-stage pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer, providing basic physical protection. However, there is a lack of marked crossing infrastructure and visible pedestrian-scale lighting, and the sidewalk shows signs of minor maintenance neglect with vegetation growth.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk is visible despite complex road markings that may indicate an intersection or high-traffic area.

hazards.name: Sidewalk maintenance issues
hazards.description: Grass and weeds are growing through the sidewalk joints, which can create tripping hazards or reduce the effective width over time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing points and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures specifically designed to illuminate the sidewalk and crossing areas rather than just the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear vegetation and repair joints to ensure a smooth, unobstructed walking surface.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed multi-lane arterial road with a narrow sidewalk separated by a grass buffer. There is a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure, and the environment is heavily prioritized for motor vehicle throughput.

hazards.name: High-speed arterial design
hazards.description: Multiple wide travel lanes and lack of traffic calming encourage high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right of image, the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals are visible for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked in the shoulder/buffer area block visibility between pedestrians and moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, adjacent to the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage to designate pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing narrow sidewalk to provide a more comfortable and accessible walking space.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by a wide multi-lane roadway adjacent to an industrial bus depot, lacking marked crossings or pedestrian signals across the main thoroughfare. While a basic crosswalk exists on the side street, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and connectivity.
